description: Scan text or a domain for homoglyph attacks: Cyrillic and Greek characters that render identically to Latin letters (а vs a, р vs p). Returns every impostor position with its Latin equivalent and the fully normalized ASCII rendering — the definitive check for spoofed brands and IDN domains. Use this when an agent needs to find look-alike characters hiding in text or domains. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_homoglyph_detect
title: Homoglyph Detector
